caption: The drawing features a decorative border design composed of stylized floral and leafy elements painted in various shades of blue. The entire motif is set against a light beige or off-white background with a faint brownish wash behind the design, providing subtle contrast. Two narrow lines run parallel above the border, indicating the edge or possible placement of the border on an object.
